mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alerts (id, kb_id, severity, kind, min_role, subject_type, subject_id, detail) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{severity}, #{kind}, #{minRole}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{detail, typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.JsonNodeTypeHandler}::jsonb)
mapper.select:
WITH v AS ( SELECT a.id, a.kb_id, k.name AS kb_name, a.severity, a.kind, a.detail, a.created_at, (r.user_id IS NOT NULL) AS read FROM alerts a LEFT JOIN knowledge_bases k ON k.id = a.kb_id LEFT JOIN alert_reads r ON r.alert_id = a.id AND r.user_id = #{userId} WHERE (CASE WHEN a.kb_id IS NULL THEN #{isAdmin}::bool ELSE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM unnest(#{kbIds,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[], #{kbRanks,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.IntegerArrayTypeHandler}::int[]) AS v(kb, rank) WHERE v.kb = a.kb_id AND v.rank >= CASE a.min_role WHEN 'viewer' THEN 0 WHEN 'editor' THEN 1 WHEN 'admin' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) END) AND ((#{q}::text IS NULL OR a.kind ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR COALESCE(k.name, '') ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR a.detail::text ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%')) ), isl AS (SELECT v.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY v.created_at DESC, v.id DESC) - row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY v.kb_id, v.kind ORDER BY v.created_at DESC, v.id DESC) AS grp FROM v)
SELECT kb_id, max(kb_name) AS kb_name, kind, -- severity 按轻重取最大，不能按字典序：那样 warning 会压过 error CASE max(CASE severity WHEN 'error' THEN 3 WHEN 'warning' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) WHEN 3 THEN 'error' WHEN 2 THEN 'warning' ELSE 'info' END AS severity, count(*) AS count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT read) AS unread, max(created_at) AS latest_at, min(created_at) AS earliest_at, (array_agg(detail ORDER BY created_at DESC))[1:5] AS lines FROM isl GROUP BY kb_id, kind, grp ORDER BY max(created_at) DESC, kb_id, kind, grp LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

WITH v AS ( SELECT a.id, a.kb_id, k.name AS kb_name, a.severity, a.kind, a.detail, a.created_at, (r.user_id IS NOT NULL) AS read FROM alerts a LEFT JOIN knowledge_bases k ON k.id = a.kb_id LEFT JOIN alert_reads r ON r.alert_id = a.id AND r.user_id = #{userId} WHERE (CASE WHEN a.kb_id IS NULL THEN #{isAdmin}::bool ELSE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM unnest(#{kbIds,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[], #{kbRanks,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.IntegerArrayTypeHandler}::int[]) AS v(kb, rank) WHERE v.kb = a.kb_id AND v.rank >= CASE a.min_role WHEN 'viewer' THEN 0 WHEN 'editor' THEN 1 WHEN 'admin' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) END) AND ((#{q}::text IS NULL OR a.kind ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR COALESCE(k.name, '') ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR a.detail::text ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%')) ), isl AS (SELECT v.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY v.created_at DESC, v.id DESC) - row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY v.kb_id, v.kind ORDER BY v.created_at DESC, v.id DESC) AS grp FROM v) SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM isl GROUP BY kb_id, kind, grp) g

SELECT count(*) FROM alerts a LEFT JOIN alert_reads r ON r.alert_id = a.id AND r.user_id = #{userId} WHERE (CASE WHEN a.kb_id IS NULL THEN #{isAdmin}::bool ELSE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM unnest(#{kbIds,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[], #{kbRanks,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.IntegerArrayTypeHandler}::int[]) AS v(kb, rank) WHERE v.kb = a.kb_id AND v.rank >= CASE a.min_role WHEN 'viewer' THEN 0 WHEN 'editor' THEN 1 WHEN 'admin' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) END) AND r.user_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert_reads (alert_id, user_id) SELECT a.id, #{userId} FROM alerts a WHERE a.kb_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{kbId} AND a.kind = #{kind} AND a.created_at BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND (CASE WHEN a.kb_id IS NULL THEN #{isAdmin}::bool ELSE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM unnest(#{kbIds,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[], #{kbRanks,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.IntegerArrayTypeHandler}::int[]) AS v(kb, rank) WHERE v.kb = a.kb_id AND v.rank >= CASE a.min_role WHEN 'viewer' THEN 0 WHEN 'editor' THEN 1 WHEN 'admin' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) END) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alert_reads r WHERE r.alert_id = a.id AND r.user_id = #{userId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO alert_reads (alert_id, user_id) SELECT a.id, #{userId} FROM alerts a WHERE (CASE WHEN a.kb_id IS NULL THEN #{isAdmin}::bool ELSE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM unnest(#{kbIds,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[], #{kbRanks,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.IntegerArrayTypeHandler}::int[]) AS v(kb, rank) WHERE v.kb = a.kb_id AND v.rank >= CASE a.min_role WHEN 'viewer' THEN 0 WHEN 'editor' THEN 1 WHEN 'admin' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) END) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
